description: Extract structured invoice header, seller, buyer, bank IBAN, tax breakdown, and line items from a ZUGFeRD PDF, XRechnung XML, or legacy flat PDF. Extracts embedded XML deterministically in ~20ms (source='NATIVE_XML') or falls back to guarded extraction on flat PDFs (source='AI_EXTRACTED'). Use for data extraction (Empfangspflicht); use validate_erechnung instead for strict KoSIT/veraPDF compliance checks. Returns JSON with source, math_verified, iban_valid, invoiceNumber, issueDate, currency, seller, buyer, items[], netTotal, vatTotal, and grossTotal.

fileBase64.description: Base64-encoded ZUGFeRD PDF, flat legacy PDF, or XRechnung XML file to parse (provide either fileBase64 or xmlContent).

filename.description: Optional original filename ending in .pdf or .xml.

xmlContent.description: Raw UTF-8 XRechnung or Factur-X XML string to parse (alternative to fileBase64).

name: parse_erechnung
